outcome: Neuroimaging data (pattern, size, distribution) of neonatal ICH
cohort: The study involved 42 term neonates less than 1 month old with ICH who underwent MRI.
finding: SDH was the most common type of ICH in term infants, and perinatal asphyxia was the most common statistically significant predictor of poor clinical outcomes.
followup_time: Mean age at MRI: 9.3 days, Clinical outcome determined for 27 neonates
